objective: Finish the remaining page264 proof-only acceptance with the fewest remote calls and at most one source + one target browser tab, while preserving the released implementation exactly.
hard_preserve: No page264 implementation write unless a fresh synchronized defect is reproduced and its exact owner/cascade is proven.
Never redeploy v001-v007 or duplicate existing marked blocks.
Do not change another page, global header/footer/dock owner, shared media, shared Form33 settings, SMTP, notifications or webhooks.
Preserve ID14/ID33 ownership, ID5/ID6, #af-form-direct-call, page264 IDs/order/hash and current plugin/theme versions.
No real MetForm submission, entry creation, upload or external delivery in this mode.

wpvibe: Make exactly one initial site/quota read after the previous HTTP 429 has clearly cleared.
If the first WPVibe call returns 429/5xx/disabled, stop WPVibe for the continuation and do not retry.
Keep at least 10 calls unused for D11 closeout/recovery.
opera: Keep or navigate at most two tabs total: one source page264 and one target page264.
Close unrelated project tabs before screenshots.
If stale/not-found/disconnected, stop Opera for the continuation; do not open replacement fan-out.

phase_1_compact_read_only_server_preflig.target: One compact read if possible, returning only scalar identity facts.
must_match: Additional CSS length/SHA plus af-project:end/v004/v005/v006/v007 marker counts
stop_if: page264 saved data drift is unexplained
any required CSS marker is missing/duplicated

phase_2_exact_source_interaction_owner.goal: Close the only remaining deployment-identity uncertainty before action testing.
phase_2_exact_source_interaction_owner.read: Exact current Head & Footer Code option auhfc_settings_sitewide: length, SHA256, count of __AF_SOURCE_INTERACTIONS_V001__, and only the bounded marked source-interaction block if a hash/content comparison is required.
phase_2_exact_source_interaction_owner.expected: Exactly one marker and a declaration-equivalent copy of build/source-interactions-v001.js, with no second DB/runtime owner.

decision.exact_match: PASS runtime identity; continue proof-only actions.
decision.drift: STOP and reconcile the exact current runtime before any behavior conclusion. Do not overwrite it from a stale snapshot.

phase_3_action_proof_order.why_ordered: Run cheapest deterministic interactions first and reuse the same two tabs/state; do not reopen already-passed static work.

tests.source_target: Observe initial open states, pointer activation, keyboard Enter/Space behavior, focus integrity and whether multiple disclosures can stay open.
tests.write_if_fail: None by default. First prove exact owner; native details should be preserved whenever possible.

tests.source_target: Synchronize both at value50; test keyboard and pointer movement; require range value and --ba-pos to stay synchronized.
tests.write_if_fail: None without stable reproduced target-only failure and current source-interaction owner proof.

tests.source_target: Synchronize selected review; test ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down/Home/End plus prev/next and visual-dot pointer behavior.
tests.write_if_fail: Read ID14/ID33 current body first; page264 may not mutate global ID14.

tests.source_target: Synchronize slide index/caption; record carousel--manual. On non-manual instance verify ~4000ms fresh autoplay, successful navigation -> start() interval reset, ArrowLeft/Right, >=40px horizontally dominant swipe, simple/compound hover-focus pause behavior and reduced-motion. Compare current/noncurrent role/aria-hidden and all six caption/alt entries.
tests.drop_contract: Direct source truth: zero remaining -> stop()+hide+return; one remaining -> stop()+go(); two or more remaining -> drop() itself does not stop/restart solely because of removal. Do not manufacture broken images merely to force this edge case.
tests.write_if_fail: None without stable target-only failure and exact current runtime owner.

tests.source_target: Use a non-delivery/client-side validation action only to prove empty kapcsolat-tema is blocked and the current native message appears. Do not submit Form33 to its REST insert route.
tests.write_if_fail: Only after proving native required actually fails; prefer existing page264 owner ID33, never shared Form33 mutation from this scope.

phase_4_hero_diagnostic_only.viewport_first: Use the same stable desktop viewport that reproduced the historical offset before any multi-view matrix.
measure_both: h1 rect and line boxes if available
phase_4_hero_diagnostic_only.decision: Only if a target-only delta survives identical browser/state and an exact winning/losing declaration is named may a page264-local correction be prepared. Otherwise record PASS/measurement-no-fix.

read_only_first: fresh target dock DOM ancestry/classes and link geometry
current matching Additional CSS and shared owner declarations
phase_5_dock_scope_gate.rule: No global dock/header/footer write from page264. If the actual owner is shared/global and cannot be corrected strictly below body.page-id-264 without breaking other pages, record it as a scope blocker rather than changing it.

phase_6_deterministic_matrix.memory_strategy: Reuse the same two tabs and process viewports sequentially; after each viewport persist only the required evidence and discard transient screenshots from browser memory if the connector permits. Never fan out one tab per viewport.
phase_6_deterministic_matrix.state: Same browser engine, DPR, zoom, font/image readiness, scroll position and motion state. Synchronize reviews/carousel or exclude their moving pixels from static diff.
known_breakpoints: contact strong .92rem/right padding <=560 and button width100% <=400
phase_6_deterministic_matrix.pixel_pass_rule: Set PIXEL_PASS only after this matrix actually completes with documented thresholds; never infer it from targeted v006/v007 PASS.

call_budget_estimate.browser_actions: Opera connector actions do not spend WPVibe calls but are memory-limited to two tabs.
call_budget_estimate.rule: Do not spend WPVibe calls on repeated HTML/static facts already accepted.

stop_conditions: Fresh saved-data/marker/runtime identity drift is unexplained.
No stable synchronized source state for an interaction/geometry comparison.
A suspected issue cannot be isolated to a page264-authorized owner/cascade.
Two attempted diagnostics produce no measurable narrowing; stop rather than stack CSS/JS guesses.
